## Soft Metadata

> [!WARNING]
> **Tier 2 (community estimate)** — Soft Metadata below adapted from Wiley publisher pages and domain knowledge of applied cognitive psychology editorial culture (SARMAC). Submission practitioners are invited to upgrade individual claims to Tier 1 via `/ja-validate`. See [SEED_DATA_QUALITY.md](../../../../SEED_DATA_QUALITY.md) for the Skeleton → Tier 2 → Tier 1 lifecycle.

> **The core value of this entry.** OpenAlex cannot fill any of these — they require lived experience and community knowledge. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../../../../CONTRIBUTING.md) for guidance.

### Epistemological & Political Leanings

| Dimension | Assessment |
|-----------|------------|
| **Cross-cultural friendliness** | High |
| **Non-Western epistemology openness** | Medium |
| **Diversity topic receptiveness** | Medium-High |
| **Dominant theoretical tradition** | Applied cognitive psychology — eyewitness memory, autobiographical memory, false memory, applied attention, real-world cognition, forensic cognition, cognitive aging applications |

### Framing Requirements

- **Mandatory framing?** Yes (soft)
- **If yes, what kind?** Manuscripts must demonstrate **applied cognitive psychology contribution** — real-world relevance to memory, attention, judgment, or applied cognition.
- **Consequences of ignoring it**: Pure basic cognitive work redirected to JEP family or Cognition.

## Strategic Notes

### Hard Blockers

- Manuscripts without applied cognitive contribution
- AI use without disclosure per Wiley policy
- Pure basic cognitive psychology without real-world relevance

### Soft Tax

Low for applied cognitive tradition authors.

### Best Suited For

- Eyewitness memory research
- Autobiographical and false memory studies
- Forensic cognition empirical work
- Applied attention research
- Cognitive aging applications
- Educational cognition studies

### Not Recommended For

- Pure basic cognitive psychology (consider JEP family, Cognition)
- Pure cognitive neuroscience (consider JoCN)
- Pure clinical psychology

### Rejection Fallback Chain

| Rank | Journal | Why this fallback works |
|------|---------|------------------------|
| 1 | [Journal of Experimental Psychology Learning Memory and Cognition](../cognitive-science/journal-of-experimental-psychology-learning-memory-and-cognition.md) | If basic cognitive reframing; APA |
| 2 | [Cognitive Psychology](../cognitive-science/cognitive-psychology.md) | If theoretical-cognitive contribution; Elsevier |
| 3 | *(Memory & Cognition — community contribution welcome)* | Psychonomic Society peer |

**Reverse direction** *(optional)*: If your paper was rejected from JEP:LMC as "too applied," ACP is the Wiley SARMAC-affiliated home.
